These tiny images are synthetic fixtures generated by
`python3 tools/generate-fixtures.py`. They contain a red left half and blue right
half (48 × 32 pixels). The GIF includes a second green frame; Rajo intentionally
displays its initial still frame. The alpha PNG has a transparent top-left pixel.
The orientation JPEGs cover all eight EXIF transformations.

Generating fixtures requires Pillow, pillow-heif, and ffmpeg with libaom-av1.
The generated files are checked in, so these tools are not needed to build or
run Rajo, or to run its Rust tests. No personal photos or third-party media are
included.
